messages.en:
{07 04 00}Huh? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 16 00}Wassup, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Hey, you look like someone
looking for trouble{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Eh? {01 00 00 0a 00}You want to have a
contest {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}to see which of us
can catch the rarer bug?
{07 15 00}Aren't you the bold one?{01 00 00 0a 00}
I gotta tell you, {01 00 00 05 00}I like what
I'm hearing, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}.
{07 16 00}OK, OK, fine. {01 00 00 05 00}I'm the one
who wants to do this whole
bug-challenge thing.
{07 00 00}Aw, you know you love it.{01 00 00 05 00}
Anyway, {01 00 00 05 00}get out there and
catch something! {01 00 00 05 00}Man up!{01 00 00 05 00}
When you think you've got a
decent find, bring it back
to me, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 04 00}Ah? {01 00 00 14 00}{07 16 00}Mis toimub, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}?{01 00 00 0a 00}
Hei, sa näed nagu keegi,
kes otsib pahandust{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 00 00}Mis? {01 00 00 0a 00}Sa tahad võistlust {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}et
näha, kumb meist püüab
haruldasema putuka?
{07 15 00}Sa oled küll julge!{01 00 00 0a 00}
Pean ütlema, {01 00 00 05 00}see meeldib

{07 16 00}Olgu, olgu. {01 00 00 05 00}Mina olen see,
kes tahab kogu seda
putukaväljakutset teha.
{07 00 00}Oh, sulle ju meeldib see.{01 00 00 05 00}
Igatahes, {01 00 00 05 00}mine sinna ja

Kui arvad, et leid on hea,
too see mulle
tagasi, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 01 00}Hey, what's your problem?{01 00 00 05 00}
You're looking like a lazy
slacker, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0c 00}I got it!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}I'll go and catch
a bug so amazing, it'll snap
you outta that stupor!
{07 0b 00}How 'bout it? {01 00 00 0a 00}You up for a
little friendly competition?{01 00 00 05 00}
Huh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
It's a race to see who can
nab the rarer bug...

And who can make the other
person's eyes pop outta
their head, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 01 00}Hei, mis sul viga on?{01 00 00 05 00}
Sa näed välja nagu laisk
logard, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0c 00}Sain!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Ma lähen ja püüan
nii vinge putuka, et see

See on võidujooks, kes

Ja kes suudab teise

{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
